newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish bonds slip, await Irish credit growth data.
newsitem.headline: Irish bonds slip, await Irish credit growth data.

text.p: Irish bonds remained weak in slow-moving afternoon trade on Thursday as dealers awaited Irish private-sector credit growth data due at 1630 GMT.
"Irish bonds are going into the credit numbers fairly stable after making most of their losses in the morning after a weaker global market trend," one dealer said.
By 1605 GMT the eight percent bond due 2000 was 25p weaker at 105.65 to yield 6.23 percent while the eight percent bond due 2006 was down 55p at 107.45 to yield 6.81 percent.
The eight percent bond due 2015 was at 110.30, a drop of 40p, to yield 7.10.
